chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Razma al-Qazwini narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Isa al-Alawi al-Husayni narrated to us, he said: Abbad ibn Yaqub al-Asadi narrated to us, he said: Habib ibn Arta narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Dhakwan, from Amr ibn Khalid, who said: Zayd ibn Ali (peace be upon him) narrated to me while grasping his hair, he said: My father Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) narrated to me while grasping his hair, he said: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both) narrated to me while grasping his hair, he said: Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated to me while grasping his hair, from the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) while grasping his hair, he said:
Whoever harms a single hair of mine has indeed harmed me, and whoever harms me has indeed harmed God, and whoever harms God, God curses him to fill the heavens and fill the earth.

key_terms.آذى: To harm, hurt, cause injury or offense
key_terms.شعرة: A single hair, used here metaphorically for even the slightest harm
key_terms.لعنه: Cursed him, expelled from divine mercy
key_terms.ملء السماء: Filling the heavens, denoting the vastness of the curse

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about harming him and his family?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared that harming even a single hair of his is equivalent to harming God Himself, and whoever does so will receive a divine curse filling the heavens and the earth. This hadith is notable for its unique chain of transmission (musalsal) where each narrator physically grasped the hair of the previous one, going back through four Imams to the Prophet, emphasizing the gravity and physical immediacy of the teaching. The original audience would have understood 'harming a hair' as encompassing any form of hostility toward the Prophet and his family.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Razma al-Qazwini narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Isa al-`Alawi al-Husayni narrated to us. He said: `Abbad b. Ya`qub al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Habib b. Arta narrated to us from Muhammad b. Dhakwan from `Amr b. Khalid. He said: Zayd b. `Ali (as) narrated to me while he was grasping his hair: My father `Ali b. al-Husayn (as) narrated to me while he was grasping his hair. He said: Al-Husayn b. `Ali (as) narrated to me while he was grasping his hair. He said: `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to me while he was grasping onto his hair from the Messenger of Allah (s) while he was grasping onto his hair. He said:
Whoever assails one hair of mine will have assailed me, and whoever assails me has assailed Allah. Whoever assails Allah, then Allah’s curse of him will fill the heavens and fill the Earth.
